slots.role: What launched and what it works with
slots.visualRecipe: Near-white ground, dark grey ink. Two-line block laid out in its final position, left edge at 11.5%W, block about 77%W, font about 12.6%H, line pitch 15.8%H; second line carries about six small partner icons at cap height as words.
slots.motionRecipe: Blank for 4 frames (30 fps). Words switch on whole every 4 frames; icons stagger 2 frames apart with a 3-frame fade and scale. Block rises 8%H with cubic-out over 8 frames, then creeps 0.7%H. Exit: 12-frame quad-in rise of 7%H starting on a hit, hard cut on the beat.
slots.soundRecipe: Quiet sparse intro of syncopated hits on a sixteenth grid; first word on the first hit.

copySlot.purpose: Verb of introduction, product name, 'for' plus the audience's tools as icons

slots.visualRecipe: Same grid and size as the previous slot, on a second near-white. Two numbers in the accent colour.
slots.motionRecipe: One blank frame; tokens on every 3-5 frames; ease-out rise; exit is a 12-frame accelerating rise that starts on the hit one beat before the drop and cuts on the drop.
slots.soundRecipe: Intro continues; the last hit (beat -1) starts the exit.

slots.role: The strongest claim as a number
slots.visualRecipe: Full accent-colour ground, off-white semibold number at 90%W entering, 35%W at rest, centred.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut on the drop with upward carry-over drift (7.5%H, ease-out, 12 frames). On beat 1, shrink to 44%W in 8 frames with heavy motion blur, ease to 35%W; re-grow 6 frames before the swap on beat 3.
slots.soundRecipe: The drop: full, bass-heavy groove starts on this frame.

slots.visualRecipe: Same accent ground. Line one at 81%W at rest, cap 10.3%H; line two shorter and bigger, 60.5%W, cap about 23.5%H, with a 55%-opacity subline at about 6.5%H font.
slots.motionRecipe: Text swaps on beats 3 and 5; each enters at about 80% of rest size, exponential ease-out over 10-14 frames; subline 4 frames later; exit grows 30% with exponential-in and blur over 10 frames into a hard cut on beat 8.
slots.soundRecipe: Groove; swaps and cut on beats.

copySlot.purpose: Comparison, then a qualifier and its unit

slots.visualRecipe: White ground; one pill input at 69%W, about 7%H tall with a soft shadow, centred; small UI text about 1.9%H cap; blue round send button.
slots.motionRecipe: Bar rises 21%H with ease-out over 21 frames; request types with uneven rhythm; cursor glides to send with ease-out, clicks; 10 frames of total stillness; hard cut on beat 14.
slots.soundRecipe: Groove continues; the cut sits on a beat with no special hit.

slots.visualRecipe: Pale ground, light window card at 84%W bleeding off the bottom; the new product's real interface at 1:1; a table of results with one link-coloured column.
slots.motionRecipe: Window rises 10%H with ease-out over 17 frames; answer lines stream in with 4-frame fades; rows add every 4-5 frames; camera drifts and pushes in with acceleration from beat 19.6; vertical scroll with velocity-scaled blur from beat 21, landing sharp on downbeat 24; hold.
slots.soundRecipe: Groove; the scroll start and landing sit on beats.

copySlot.purpose: Short answer summary above the result rows

slots.visualRecipe: White ground, one centred two-line sentence in the body face, accent colour on the key noun with a small icon.
slots.motionRecipe: The interface fades to the empty ground over about 17 frames at 60 fps, the bare ground holds about 8 frames, then the sentence fades in word by word, one word every 2-4 frames; hold.

copySlot.purpose: A sentence placing one source among many

slots.role: Breadth as a wall of names
slots.visualRecipe: Dense grid of small labelled chips, then legible; finally one chip alone with a badge.
slots.motionRecipe: Wall dissolves in tiny over about 16 frames, creeps, then pushes in to legible size on expo-out in about 0.95 s; the others fade over about 1.3 s and one chip holds still.
slots.soundRecipe: Groove, falling to a quieter tail from about 21 s.

copySlot.purpose: Names of real sources the product uses

slots.visualRecipe: Small flat logo centred on white with faint corner crop marks.
slots.motionRecipe: The outgoing frame fades to the empty ground over about 20 frames, two bare frames, then the mark cuts on and the wordmark 4 frames later; hold to the end.
slots.soundRecipe: Music stops dead about 0.9 s into the slot; silence to the end.

rhythm.cutGrid: Anchor everything to the drop as beat 0 (beat = 12.857 frames at 30 fps). Intro of 9 1/3 beats before the drop. Cuts and swaps on beats -4, 0, 3, 5, 8, 14; motion starts on beats 1 and 21; landing on downbeat 24. Exits start on the hit one beat before their cut. Word reveals inside a sentence are free, every 4 frames.

style: Light flat grounds, a dark neutral grotesque in mixed case, one accent colour for numbers that becomes the ground once on the drop, scale as the only hierarchy, a real interface at reading scale, motion blur only on real speed, no effects.

keep: Beat-relative timing of every cut, swap and motion start
Accelerating one-beat exits and ease-out entries carried across cuts
Pre-laid-out word reveal with inline icons
Accent colour used for numbers, then once as the ground on the drop
Scale ratios between body type, hero number and interface
Click, freeze, cut before the result
Blurred scroll landing on a downbeat
Flat end card and a hard stop
mustChange: All branding, marks, product and competitor names
All graphics, icons and partner marks
All copy and numbers, which must be true for the new product
Interface: must be the new product's real one
